{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

A model that fits the data well gives the data a short [code](source-coding.qmd#def-code),
but a model that is itself long to describe costs [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit) of its own.
This page counts both costs in bits,
and chooses the model that makes the sum shortest.
